Hurricane Fleet

🚢 🛳️ 🚢 🛳️ 🚢

The same fleet, one run, no cuts — now in full 3D. You have the helm of the flagship as the carrier leads the battleships and destroyers through an open ocean — steer anywhere, and the world sails with you. The Engine Order Telegraph sets the speed and the ship spools up to it; the joystick is the rudder, port to starboard. Take command of any ship with Tab or the fleet panel, and the rest follow as escorts. Waves pitch and roll every hull. A wrecked ship lists, floods and sinks beneath the waves, and the next one takes command. Lose them all and the round ends.
